subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What should the Feishu plugin expose to agents for interactive-card ingestion: a text-only card summary, structured/raw card payloads, callback field passthrough, or a staged combination of those?
rationale: The current issue combines direct inbound card text, button/dropdown values, form inputs, and callback setup, and existing open PRs cover only parts of that surface with compatibility and message-delivery risk.

options.title: Stage the Feishu card contract
options.body: First add direct inbound text extraction using the existing parser, then resolve callback fields and merge_forward parsing through the narrower linked items.

options.title: Design one broad structured payload
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a single structured/raw card payload contract for direct messages and callbacks.

options.title: Defer advanced card parsing
options.body: Keep only the fetched/quoted read improvements and leave direct interactive-card and callback parsing unsupported for now.

recommendation.title: Stage the Feishu card contract
recommendation.body: First add direct inbound text extraction using the existing parser, then resolve callback fields and merge_forward parsing through the narrower linked items.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Feishu card parsing and sending work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the remaining product choice.
